description: TI LM339LV quad low-voltage rail-to-rail comparator, OPEN-DRAIN (sinking-only) outputs, VS 1.65-5.5 V, input common-mode range GND to V+ (extends 100 mV beyond both rails), IQ 25 uA/ch typ, Vos 0.4 mV typ, tPD 600 ns typ, no internal hysteresis, internal POR holds outputs Hi-Z until V+ > 1.5 V. NAMING WARNING: datasheet Figure 5-3 (pin drawing) and Table 5.2 (Pin Functions) transpose the channel 1/2 and 3/4 NAMES; footnote (1) of Table 5.2 acknowledges this. The pin-number-to-pin-number groupings are identical in both and are recorded in the per-pin notes below. Wire by PIN NUMBER, not by channel name.

pinout.name: OUT1
pinout.notes: Open-drain (sinking-only) comparator output. Channel formed with inputs pin 6 (IN1-) and pin 7 (IN1+). Figure 5-3 names this pin OUT2 - same pin grouping, different channel-naming convention (Table 5.2 footnote 1). Requires external pull-up; may be wire-OR'ed with other open-drain outputs.

pinout.name: OUT2
pinout.notes: Open-drain (sinking-only) comparator output. Channel formed with inputs pin 4 (IN2-) and pin 5 (IN2+). Figure 5-3 names this pin OUT1. Requires external pull-up; may be wire-OR'ed.

pinout.name: V+
pinout.notes: Positive supply. Recommended 1.65 V to 5.5 V.

pinout.name: IN2-
pinout.notes: Negative (inverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 2. Figure 5-3 names it IN1-.

pinout.name: IN2+
pinout.notes: Positive (noninverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 2. Figure 5-3 names it IN1+.

pinout.name: IN1-
pinout.notes: Negative (inverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 1. Figure 5-3 names it IN2-.

pinout.name: IN1+
pinout.notes: Positive (noninverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 1. Figure 5-3 names it IN2+.

pinout.name: IN3-
pinout.notes: Negative (inverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 14.

pinout.name: IN3+
pinout.notes: Positive (noninverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 14.

pinout.name: IN4-
pinout.notes: Negative (inverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 13.

pinout.name: IN4+
pinout.notes: Positive (noninverting) input of the comparator whose output is pin 13.

pinout.name: OUT3
pinout.notes: Open-drain (sinking-only) comparator output. Channel formed with inputs pin 10 (IN4-) and pin 11 (IN4+) - Table 5.2 names the pin OUT3 but describes it as 'Output pin of the comparator 4'; Figure 5-3 names it OUT4. Requires external pull-up; may be wire-OR'ed.

pinout.name: OUT4
pinout.notes: Open-drain (sinking-only) comparator output. Channel formed with inputs pin 8 (IN3-) and pin 9 (IN3+) - Table 5.2 names the pin OUT4 but describes it as 'Output pin of the comparator 3'; Figure 5-3 names it OUT3. Requires external pull-up; may be wire-OR'ed.

decoupling.placement: Directly between the V+ pin (3) and the GND pin (12), as close to the supply pin as possible, connected to a solid ground plane.
decoupling.notes: Section 9 Power Supply Recommendations: 'Bypass the supply directly at each device with a low ESR 0.1 uF ceramic bypass capacitor directly between VCC pin and ground pins.' Critical because of the fast output edges - un-bypassed supplies can ring and cause false triggers or oscillation.

land_pattern.notes: From LAND PATTERN DATA drawing 4211284-2/G (08/15), 'Example Board Layout': 12 x 0.65 pitch between pad centres, 14 pads of 0.35 (across) x 1.60 (along lead), 5.60 between the two pad rows centre-to-centre, solder mask opening 0.07 all around (non-soldermask-defined pad). IPC-7351 is recommended for alternate designs. Package outline (drawing 4040064-3/G): pitch 0.65, body 5.10/4.90 x 4.50/4.30, lead span 6.60/6.20, height 1.20 MAX, JEDEC MO-153.

exposed_pad.connect_to: n/a - the 14-pin TSSOP (PW) has no exposed pad. Only the RTE WQFN-16 and the DSG WSON-8 variants have a thermal pad (Table 5.2 lists 'Thermal Pad' under the WQFN column only, and Figure 5-3 shows none).

layout_notes: Outputs are OPEN-DRAIN / open-collector, sinking only: they can only pull the net low and can never drive it high. Safe to wire-OR several outputs onto one shared net (Section 7.4.1 explicitly allows 'logical OR'ing of multiple open drain outputs').
An external pull-up resistor is mandatory on every used output. TI recommends sizing the pull-up for 100 uA to 1 mA of pull-up current; pull-ups above 1 Mohm give an exponential (slow) rising edge.
The output may be pulled up to any external voltage from 0 V to 5.5 V, independent of V+ (there is no ESD clamp from OUT to V+).
Place a low-ESR 0.1 uF ceramic bypass capacitor as close to the V+ pin as possible, ideally directly between the V+ and GND pins, returned to a solid ground plane (Sections 9 and 10.1).
Output rise/fall times are tens of nanoseconds - treat the outputs as high-speed logic.
Minimize coupling between outputs and inputs to prevent output oscillation. Do not run output and input traces in parallel unless a V+ or GND trace separates them.
When series resistance is added to an input, place that resistor close to the device (Section 10.1).
A low-value (<100 ohm) series resistor may be added at an output to damp ringing/reflections on long, non-impedance-controlled traces.
Unused open-drain outputs should be left floating, or may be tied to the GND pin if floating pins are not allowed (Section 7.4.1).

Do NOT tie the two inputs of an unused channel together - the device will oscillate on its own wideband noise. Tie them to voltages inside the input range with at least 50 mV of differential (Section 7.4.5).
The device has NO internal hysteresis; add external hysteresis for slow-moving signals or the output will chatter near the trip point (Section 7.4.6).

Internal POR keeps the output HI-Z for up to 30 us after V+ crosses the 1.5 V threshold (and immediately when V+ drops below 1.5 V). During POR the output follows the pull-up voltage; a light pull-up or pull-down can pre-bias it (Section 7.4.2).

Inputs are diode-clamped to GND only - there is no ESD clamp from the inputs to V+. Inputs are fault-tolerant to 5.5 V independent of V+, and no output phase inversion occurs when inputs exceed the rails.
If an input is driven from a low-impedance source, add a series current-limiting resistor to hold any clamp current to 10 mA or less; this can be part of the input divider (Sections 7.4.3.3 / 7.4.4).
Total combined output sink current across all four channels must stay below 200 mA (an individual output can typically sink 100 mA).
Section 9 contains a boilerplate mention of a 'push-pull output device'; this device family is open-drain only (Sections 1, 7.1, 7.4.1).

abs_max.param: RECOMMENDED: input voltage range (IN+, IN-) from GND
ELEC: input common-mode voltage range VCM-Range (VS = 1.8 V and 5 V, -40 to 125 degC)
abs_max.value: (GND) to (V+) - rail-to-rail; Section 7.4.3.1 states the input range extends 100 mV below GND to 100 mV above V+

abs_max.param: ELEC: quiescent current IQ per comparator (VS = 1.8 V and 5 V, no load, output low)
abs_max.value: 25 typ / 35 max at 25 degC, 50 max over -40 to 125 degC (x4 channels for the package total)

abs_max.param: ELEC: input offset voltage VOS (VS = 1.8 V and 5 V)
abs_max.value: +/-0.4 typ, +/-2 max at 25 degC, +/-3 max over temperature

abs_max.param: ELEC: output low voltage VOL (ISINK = 4 mA)
abs_max.value: 150 typ / 200 max at 25 degC, 300 max over temperature

abs_max.param: ELEC: open-drain output leakage current ILKG (VPULLUP = V+, 25 degC)
ELEC: input bias current IB (VCM = VS/2)
ELEC: propagation delay tPD (VS = 5 V, 10 mV overdrive, RP = 2.5 kohm, CL = 15 pF)
ELEC: short-circuit / max sink current ISC (VS = 5 V, sinking)
abs_max.value: 60 typ / 100 max per output; 200 total across all channels

abs_max.param: ELEC: power-on time PON (POR, output HI-Z during this window)
abs_max.value: 50 typ (POR active up to 30 us after V+ crosses 1.5 V)
